description: NaCoP₂HO₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one H and seven O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.48 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.97 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.62 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one CoO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.28 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one CoO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.30 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three CoO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-50°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.61 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three CoO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-50°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.61 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three CoO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-59°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.62 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three CoO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-59°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.62 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.11 Å) and one longer (1.34 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.07 Å) and one longer (1.40 Å) H-O bond length. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Co, one P, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Co, one P, and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one P, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one P, and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Co, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Co, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Co and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Co, and one P atom.
